name: data-reasoning
description: Skills for reasoning from data — structured exploration that generates honest leads, hypothesis-driven investigation that adjudicates them, causal identification review that turns a dead end into a reviewed, assumption-bounded design, and decision analysis that turns unresolved evidence into a defensible act-wait-or-collect verdict.

interface.shortDescription: Explore data and test hypotheses with disciplined workflows
interface.longDescription: Use structured workflows for exploratory data analysis, hypothesis-driven investigation, and causal identification review, with explicit evidence, predictions, stopping rules, and assumption-bounded designs when nothing else identifies the effect, and decision analysis for choosing under uncertainty with robustness-checked verdicts.
defaultPrompt: Explore this dataset and identify the strongest leads.
Turn this question into a hypothesis-driven analysis plan.
Evaluate whether the evidence supports these competing hypotheses.
Review whether this design identifies the effect, and on what assumptions.
Decide whether to act, wait, or collect more data given this evidence.
